JourneyHeading: The Evolution of Stay - Transforming the Worlds of Cryptocurrency and Fitness

JourneyContent.p1: Discover the journey Stay has embarked on to revolutionize the realms of cryptocurrency and fitness. With each milestone achieved, we move closer to our vision of a healthier and more prosperous community.
JourneyContent.p2: Since its inception, Stay has represented much more than a mere cryptocurrency; it is a movement aimed at integrating digital currency into daily activities to promote a healthy lifestyle.
JourneyContent.p3: Our dedicated team has developed and launched various features that not only increase user engagement but also offer tangible benefits, solidifying Stay as a leader in its sector
JourneyContent.p4: Stay is not just about investment; it's about building a dynamic and thriving community. Each coin holder not only contributes to the growth and success of the network but also reaps rewards of this success.
JourneyContent.p5: Looking forward with enthusiasm, we are poised to expand our reach through new and exciting collaborations, enhance capabilities of our platform, and continue innovating at the intersection of technology and well-being

FAQ.question: When is the Presale?
FAQ.answer: Pending to set a date for the presale at 12AM UTC.

FAQ.question: The official address to deposit Solana and purchase STAY will be displayed only on?
FAQ.answer: at 12AM UTC on the website https://staycripto.com/. Beware of scammers! Only use the address shown on that website and on our official Telegram, Instagram, and X accounts.

FAQ.question: How long does the Pre-Sale last?
FAQ.answer: ending to set a date 24 12AM UTC.

FAQ.question: When will the STAY Token be listed?
FAQ.answer: The STAY token will be listed and tradable shortly after the pre-sale ends and all tokens have been distributed to pre-sale buyers.

FAQ.question: On what exchanges will STAY be listed right after Pre-Sale?
FAQ.answer: The project team intends to list STAY on Raydium and Orca and further DEXes.

FAQ.question: Will STAY be listed on Tier1 Exchanges?
FAQ.answer: Yes, we plan to list Stay on major exchanges. The STAY project team has successfully listed prior projects on Binance, ByBit, OKX, Kucoin, BitGet and Bitfinex.

FAQ.question: When is the distribution of my purchased STAY taking place?
FAQ.answer: The distribution will take place 30-60 minutes after official token listings on DEX.

FAQ.question: What is the Max Supply of STAY?
FAQ.answer: There will be 110.920.012.980.000.00 STAY in Circulation.

FAQ.question: Does the project have reputable Market Makers and Liquidity Management?
FAQ.answer: Drawing from over 7 years of experience from the core founding team in creating and managing tokens with volumes in the tens of millions, STAY has had a very professional Market-Making setup from Day 1 and allocates a significant portion of project funds to liquidity.

FAQ.question: Are promoters/influencers and the team subject to a vesting schedule?
FAQ.answer: The early contributors' group is under vesting, and the project is led by successful entrepreneurs who have previously built a multi-billion-dollar company. Therefore, there are no incentives for speculative buying and selling operations. The primary goal is to establish a strong and large community and create one of the first 'major meme tokens' centered around the narrative of wellness, health, and fitness.

FAQ.question: Will there be airdrops?
FAQ.answer: Yes. We will share airdrop activities on our social channels. Make sure to follow/subscribe and participate in our exclusive games to earn additional rewards. 1.5% of the circulating supply is allocated to airdrops.

FAQ.question: Will the Smart Contract have an audit?
FAQ.answer: Yes on Solana (SOL) network be audited by a reputable provider to ensure its security and reliability!

FAQ.question: Can American or Chinese investors participate?
FAQ.answer: No, the pre-sale excludes any citizen or resident of the United States, as well as Chinese investors. Additionally, investors from any sanctioned country are not permitted to invest. All transactions are subject to automatic anti-money laundering (AML) checks to ensure a healthy community of token holders from the outset.
